questions.question: You reported 4 broken areas (transaction values, readjustment waveforms, repayment allocation, UI validations). When tests I add reproduce those bugs, what do you want me to do?

options.label: Write tests + fix the bugs
options.description: I add tests that capture correct behavior, run them (they fail), then fix the production code until they pass. One bundled deliverable.

options.label: Tests only, mark failing ones
options.description: I add tests covering correct behavior. Where the production code is wrong I mark them with a clear assertion + note (no skip), leave the code untouched, and hand you a list of failures to fix.

options.label: Tests + fix only the obvious bugs
options.description: I fix anything where the correct behavior is unambiguous, and leave a handoff list for anything ambiguous (e.g. spec-level questions about waveform shape).

questions.question: For UI validation tests, which tool?

options.label: Dusk (browser, headless) (Recommended)
options.description: Per your memory: UI features must run overlapping Dusk tests. I add tests/Browser/CreditLine*Test.php covering create, repay, readjust validation states (over-borrow, bad date, bad term, etc.).

options.label: HTTP feature tests only
options.description: Hit the validation via POST/PUT and assert error bag / status. Faster, no Chromedriver, but doesn't catch JS-side issues.

options.label: Both
options.description: Dusk for the visible validation states + HTTP feature tests for the rule matrix (faster, easier to enumerate every field).

questions.question: Can you spell out the four bugs concretely, or do you want me to discover them?

options.label: Discover from code + tests
options.description: I read code, write spec-driven tests, and report what's wrong. Slower but you don't have to write up reproducers.

options.label: I'll describe them now
options.description: You give me concrete reproducers (e.g. 'borrowed X shares on date Y, repaid Z, display shows W but should show V'). Faster + more accurate.

options.label: Mix — discover but ask when unclear
options.description: I start discovering and ping you with specific questions where the expected behavior is ambiguous.

I have found multiple issues with the new credit lines:

* transactions were not displaying right values

I have found multiple issues with the new credit lines:

* transactions were not displaying right values

* readjustments were not generating right waveforms
* repayments were not allocated correctly
* validations were not correct (ui)

I want you to review all testcases, expand them, after extensive tests on the functionality side, add separate UI tests and validations.
I have a clear map of the credit-line surface area now. Before I start writing/expanding tests, I want to nail down scope so I don't do the wrong thing — this touches a lot of code.

expected.rec_session: Tests only, mark failing ones, Dusk (browser, headless) (Recommended), Discover from code + tests
